{{Quote|There we go. All the comforts of home.|Dubrak Qennto|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
A small [[Color/Legends|yellow]] '''sun''' was located in an [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two)|star system]], approximately 250 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] from that region's border with [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Outbound" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'' arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] after a blind [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dubrak Qennto]], noted his satisfaction at the presence of the [[Star/Legends|star]], in contrast disapprovingly characterizing interstellar [[Realspace/Legends|space]], into which the original jump had previously deposited the [[Starship/Legends|starship]], as "dark and cold and lonely."<ref name="Outbound" />

==Behind the scenes==
The star appeared in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' indirectly placed it in grid square I-7.<ref name="Grid" />
